description.p: RYZ Authenticator is a native, ultra-lightweight (~30 MB RAM), zero-knowledge Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) application built in Rust and Tauri 2.0. It encrypts all TOTP and HOTP secrets locally using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, supports live webcam/phone QR scanning, 1-step Google Authenticator migration import, and encrypted offline backups.
Multi-platform live camera QR scanner, 6s hold-to-delete safety guard, Base32 secret validator, and E2EE cloud sync.
